name: Ramya Sree Narra
headline: Software Engineer
summary: Software engineer with experience across distributed backend systems, full-stack web development and applied AI, including RAG systems and an AI agent for production incident analysis at Google.

bullets.text: Developed an AI-powered production investigation agent to automate incident analysis and debugging, reducing investigation time by 60% and streamlining root-cause analysis.

Reduced SWAN policy update latency from 5 days to immediate rollouts by decoupling policy configurations from binary releases and integrating with CDPush, enabling zero-downtime updates across 130+ GCE zones.
Proposed and developed a developer workflow tool to automate policy change summaries, reducing review time by ~80% and simplifying configuration review.
Built a RAG-based clinical QA system using transformer embeddings and FAISS to retrieve relevant information from 120K+ records, improving retrieval relevance by 45% over keyword search.

Developed NER, relation extraction, and summarization pipelines using BERT and transformers to identify clinical entities, improving F1-score from 0.72 to 0.89 and reducing document review time by 60%.

Designed and launched configurable entry limits and a live events form across iOS, Android, and Web, driving 26K+ player entries, reducing developer setup time by 30%, and increasing monetized events by 10%.
Deployed scalable Spring Boot REST APIs with Redis caching to support high-concurrency traffic, achieving ~200ms average latency and reliable data retrieval.

Architected fault-tolerant, distributed event-driven systems using Kafka between EPC and Common Catalog repositories, achieving 99% message delivery accuracy across high-throughput telecom data pipelines.

Designed a large-scale observability platform integrated with Elasticsearch for centralized log aggregation and real-time search, eliminating manual Kibana checks and saving ~4 hours per debugging cycle.
Led end-to-end development of a drag-and-drop web framework using React (Hooks, Context API) and Redux, empowering non-technical users to build front-end pages and reducing coding time by 70%.

Built CI/CD pipelines using Python and GitLab CI with Cerberus scripts to detect dependency cycles and format errors, eliminating manual merge reviews and saving ~10 hours/week in engineering overhead.
Containerized Python microservices with Docker for environment consistency and reproducibility, reducing setup time by 50%.
Refactored legacy components and added cross-browser support in the BMS application, cutting browser-specific issues by 40% and enabling seamless use on Chrome and IE.
Participated in code reviews and gave feedback to improve code quality, decreasing post-merge defects by ~20%.

Built an AI platform that converts natural-language clinical questions into SQL using FAISS vector search over the schema, RAG and the Gemini API, with read-only execution guardrails and a self-correcting retry on SQL errors.
Engineered a full-stack ordering platform with JWT authentication, role-based access control and Stripe payments confirmed by signed webhooks, with server-side pricing and integration tests.
Built real-time object detection for images and webcam video with SSD MobileNet v3 on OpenCV, fixing a COCO label-mapping bug and adding a JSON-output CLI and tests.

education.degree: Master of Science in Computer Science
